paragraphs.text: Hippo is a rarely used creature type used for cards that depict a species of very large herbivorous four-toed, chiefly aquatic, mammals with extremely large heads and mouths, bare and very thick grayish skin, and short legs.

Hippos appear mainly in green . The first creature to bear the type was Bull Hippo in Urza's Saga , though Pygmy Hippo from Visions (originally subtype Hippopotamus ) was issued errata to become a Hippo as well. These were the only Hippo creature cards until the release of Amonkhet and the card Defiant Greatmaw , followed by Rampaging Hippo in Hour of Devastation .
War of the Spark features a big blue zombie -potamus in Lazotep Behemoth . Ikoria: Lair of Behemoths features another Legendary hippo in Keruga, the Macrosage
Phelddagrifs are purple-winged Hippos, which can create Hippo tokens.
